definitions.explanation: The difference in air temperature between two times, places, or conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝晩|あさばん}→朝晩：28955_asaban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気温差|きおんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
examples.english: The temperature difference between morning and evening is extreme.

examples.japanese: {気温差|きおんさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}し→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧やすい。
examples.english: Temperature fluctuations make it easy to get sick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{室外|しつがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気温差|きおんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{結露|けつろ}→結露：11084_ketsuro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: When the temperature difference between indoors and outdoors is large, condensation forms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気温差|きおんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{十度|じゅうど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In spring, the daily temperature difference can exceed ten degrees.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧ (air temperature) + ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ (difference). Very common in weather forecasts, health advice, and daily conversation, especially during seasonal transitions when large temperature swings can cause health issues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気温差|きおんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: the temperature difference is extreme
- {気温差|きおんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: the temperature gap is large
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気温差|きおんさ}: daily temperature range
- ⟦{朝晩|あさばん}→朝晩：28955_asaban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気温差|きおんさ}: morning-evening temperature difference
- {気温差|きおんさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: catch a cold due to temperature changes

USAGE:
Often appears in health-related contexts. Japanese weather reports frequently warn about ⟦{寒暖差|かんだんさ}→寒暖差：07865_kandansa⟧ (hot-cold difference), which is synonymous. The concept of ⟦{寒暖差|かんだんさ}→寒暖差：07865_kandansa⟧⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧ (fatigue from temperature swings) is commonly discussed in health media.
